title: Executive Brief Template
description: Standard structure for a leadership-ready brief
content:
EXECUTIVE BRIEF

Date: [Date]
Prepared by: [Name / Role]
Subject: [Topic]
Classification: [e.g. Internal Use Only]

1. BACKGROUND
[2-3 sentences on context and why this brief is needed]

2. CURRENT SITUATION
[Key observations, data points, and status update]

3. DECISION POINTS
[What needs to be decided or approved]

4. RISKS AND CONSIDERATIONS
[Key risks, constraints, and factors leadership should be aware of]

5. OPTIONS
Option A: [Brief description, pros, cons]
Option B: [Brief description, pros, cons]

6. RECOMMENDATION
[Preferred option and rationale]

7. NEXT STEPS
[Action items with owner and deadline]

REVIEWER: [Name]       DATE: [Date]
NOTE: If AI-assisted, verify all facts, figures, and claims before circulation.

title: Responsible AI Checklist
description: Pre-use and post-use AI governance checklist
content:
RESPONSIBLE AI USE CHECKLIST

BEFORE USE
[ ] The task is clearly defined and the AI tool is appropriate for it
[ ] Only dummy, public, or approved data is being used
[ ] No personal, confidential, classified, or restricted information is included
[ ] The level of sensitivity of the task has been assessed (Low / Medium / High)
[ ] The appropriate free/approved tool has been selected

DURING USE
[ ] The prompt includes a constraint against inventing facts
[ ] The output format is specified in the prompt
[ ] A role and context have been provided
[ ] The prompt avoids sensitive names, data, or operational details

AFTER USE
[ ] All factual claims in the output have been verified
[ ] The output has been reviewed by a qualified person
[ ] Any invented or uncertain content has been removed or flagged
[ ] The output is appropriate for the intended audience
[ ] The reviewer is named and the review is documented
[ ] Any official use of the output has been authorised

CLASSIFICATION: Low Risk [ ] / Medium Risk [ ] / High Risk [ ]
Reviewed by: _______________       Date: _______________

title: Prompt Quality Rubric
content:
PROMPT QUALITY RUBRIC

Prompt being evaluated: [Insert prompt]

EVALUATION CRITERIA

1. ROLE (0-1)
Score 1 if a clear professional role is specified (e.g. 'Act as an executive assistant')
Score 0 if no role is provided
Score: ___

2. CONTEXT (0-1)
Score 1 if relevant background information is included
Score 0 if context is absent or vague
Score: ___

3. TASK (0-1)
Score 1 if the task is specific and actionable
Score 0 if the task is vague (e.g. 'Help me with this')
Score: ___

4. OUTPUT FORMAT (0-1)
Score 1 if the desired output format is specified (e.g. table, bullet list, memo)
Score 0 if no format is stated
Score: ___

5. CONSTRAINTS (0-1)
Score 1 if constraints are included (e.g. 'Do not invent facts', 'Use only the supplied text')
Score 0 if no constraints are specified
Score: ___

6. EVALUATION CRITERIA (0-1)
Score 1 if quality standards or success criteria are mentioned
Score 0 if none are provided
Score: ___

TOTAL SCORE: ___ / 6
INTERPRETATION: 6 = Excellent | 4-5 = Good | 2-3 = Needs Improvement | 0-1 = Rebuild
NOTES: _______________

title: AI Adoption Readiness Checklist
description: Organisational readiness assessment for AI adoption
content:
AI ADOPTION READINESS CHECKLIST

STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT
[ ] AI use cases are aligned with organisational priorities
[ ] Leadership has been briefed on AI plans
[ ] A clear purpose and success definition exists for each use case

DATA GOVERNANCE
[ ] Permitted and prohibited data types are defined
[ ] A data classification framework is in place
[ ] Staff understand what must not be uploaded to external tools

PEOPLE AND SKILLS
[ ] Key users have received basic AI literacy training
[ ] Prompt-writing guidance has been provided
[ ] A point of contact for AI questions is identified

PROCESS SAFEGUARDS
[ ] A human review step is built into all AI-assisted workflows
[ ] Approval authority for AI-assisted documents is defined
[ ] An audit trail process is established

GOVERNANCE AND OVERSIGHT
[ ] An approved use-case list exists (Allowed / Restricted / Prohibited)
[ ] A periodic review of AI use is scheduled
[ ] An escalation pathway is in place for misuse or error

READINESS SCORE: ___ / 20 items ticked
ASSESSMENT DATE: _______________       ASSESSED BY: _______________

title: Stakeholder Communication Template
content:
STAKEHOLDER COMMUNICATION

Date: [Date]
From: [Name / Role]
To: [Stakeholder group]
Subject: [Topic]

1. CONTEXT
[Why this communication is being sent and what it relates to]

2. KEY MESSAGE
[The main point the recipient needs to understand]

3. ACTION REQUIRED
[What the recipient needs to do, if anything]

4. TIMELINE
[Key dates or deadlines]

5. RISKS / CONCERNS ACKNOWLEDGED
[Any concerns the audience is likely to have, and how they are being addressed]

6. CONTACT FOR QUERIES
[Name, role, and preferred contact method]

NOTE: If AI-assisted, review tone, accuracy, and authority level before sending. Confirm that all factual details are correct and that the message is authorised for circulation.

title: Decision Matrix Template
